title: S1-B Vanderbilt ref + classroom text

turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. The attached picture is the MAN; he must look exactly like this, same face, hair, sideburns and clothes, rendered in colour. He stands in the centre aisle of this room, facing the camera: Rectangular classroom viewed diagonally from the rear left at standing eye height. Rows of narrow brown wooden desks and matching chairs on gray metal frames face the right wall. A large dark green chalkboard covers that wall, beside pinned papers and above exposed white conduits. A raised dark wooden platform holds a gray teacher’s desk, black monitor, and chair near the windows. Tall gridded windows span the far wall, with patterned upper panes, clear lower panes showing trees, and several box air conditioners inset high up. Green square lockers stand against the left wall. Cream walls have beige lower sections. Glossy dark brown flooring reflects daylight. White ceiling beams carry fluorescent fixtures, fans, and a suspended projector. He is the only person. Daylight from the windows.

must_haves: The man is recognisably the man in the attached portrait.

The room matches the description (rows of narrow brown wooden desks on grey metal frames, green chalkboard on the right wall, tall gridded windows on the far wall with box air conditioners, green lockers on the left, glossy dark brown floor).
